resource.description: Latest USD price of BTC, ETH, SOL, NQ, ES, YM from the Taifoon venue tape: the close of the last closed 1-minute bar, its time, age and sha256 digest, replayable with one GET. Only symbols the tape holds; a price older than 180 s is never served as current (nothing is charged). BTC, ETH, SOL are held to Chainlink on Base within 1 % when its feed is under 1 h old. 0.001714 USDC a call.

example.source: the Taifoon venue tape (https://clob.taifoon.dev/tape/v1/candles/ETH/1m): the close of the last closed 1-minute bar

symbol.description: the symbol to price: one the Taifoon venue tape holds

age_s.description: seconds since the bar closed; at most 180, else no price is served

digest.description: sha256 over the bar’s "t,o,h,l,c,v" line (the market.candles digest)

replay.description: the tape GET that returns the same bar

without_x402.why: x402 is settled on eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum One), eip155:5042 (Arc), eip155:4663 (Robinhood Chain), eip155:143 (Monad), solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (Solana): pay the entry of the network you hold the dollar token on. A key with a balance is the other way to pay, the same price on any of them.

direct.quote: GET https://www.taifoon.io/v1/access/quote?usdc=1&chainId=<id> with X-API-Key (POST /v1/register for one), then POST /v1/access/topup { tx, signature, chainId }
direct.then: send the same request with X-API-Key: it is paid from the balance at the same price

terms.source: the Taifoon venue tape (clob.taifoon.dev /tape/v1/candles, the market.candles source): the close of the last closed 1-minute bar; no other feed
terms.basis: the price is the one rule's (_UNDERCUT_v3_, owner 2026-11-14, packages/products/undercut.mjs; its answer is `priced`): 20 % under the cheapest seller with matching skills on the x402 venues, never under our cost (`cost_units`) × 1.2; with no matching seller, cost × 1.2. The one rule replaces market.candles' max(list, cost x 1.5) for this class (owner 2026-11-03)
terms.not_advice: Facts about past prices and past fills; not advice.
